name: py_inter
short_desc: Write a function that returns a string with the characters that appear in both strings, without...
description:
Write a function that returns a string with the characters that appear
in both strings, without repetitions. Characters are added in the order
they appear in the first string.

Your function must be declared as follows:

    def inter(s1: str, s2: str) -> str:

Examples:
    inter("hello", "world")   -> "lo"
    inter("banana", "band")   -> "ban"
    inter("abcabc", "bc")     -> "bc"
    inter("abc", "xyz")       -> ""
    inter("", "abc")          -> ""
prototype: def inter(s1: str, s2: str) -> str:
notes: Return the value — do not print it.
